column3: PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (PI)

column2: Discipline Knowledge. Ability to apply mathematics, sciences, and principles of engineering to solve complex electrical engineering problems.

column3: Introduce the principles mathematics, sciences, and engineering that describe the behavior and performance of physical systems and processes
Apply the principles of mathematics, sciences, and engineering to electrical engineering problems.
Solve complex electrical engineering problems using mathematics, scientific, and engineering principles.

column2: Investigation. Ability to develop and conduct appropriate experimentation, analyze and interpret data, and use engineering judgment to draw conclusions;

column3: Acquire knowledge and ability to develop and conduct experimentations/ simulations.
Interpret experimental/ simulation data and results with respect to appropriate theoretical models/constraints.
Evaluate observed differences between model and experiment/simulation results and draw conclusions.

column2: Design/Development of Solutions. Design solution, system, components, processes, exhibiting improvements/ innovations, that meet specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, cultural, societal, economical, ethical, environmental, and sustainability issues.

column3: Introduce the design principles involved in the design of solutions, systems, components, or processes with consideration to public constaints.
Apply engineering principles to design a system, components, or processes that meet the customer's needs.

a. Formulate mathematical or simulation model(s) considering public health, safety, cultural, social, ethical, economic, environmental, and sustainability issues. b. Build a prototype or design model that meets the customer's specific needs.

column2: Leadership and Teamwork. Function effectively as a member or a leader of a diverse team whose members together provide leadership, create a collaborative and inclusive environment, establish goals, plan tasks, and meet objectives.

column3: Acquire knowledge and self-confidence to be a functioning member or leader in a diverse team.
Create a collaborative environment and accomplish individual responsibilities that contribute to the team’s success.
a. Establish goals, action plans, and activities to meet objectives. b. Act as a leader in multidisciplinary teams.

column2: Problem Analysis. Identify, formulate, and solve complex electrical engineering problems by applying principles of engineering, science, and mathematics;

column3: Acquire knowledge in identifying, formulating, and solving complex electrical engineering problems.
Formulate the mathematical or solution model for the identified problem.
Analyze and solve the problem.

column2: Ethics and Professionalism. Apply ethical principles and professional responsibilities in engineering situations and make informed judgments, which must consider the impact of engineering solutions in global, environmental, and societal contexts.

column3: Acquire basic knowledge on ethical and professional responsibilities in the societal context of an engineering situation.
Apply ethical and professional conduct in handling responsibilities related to an engineering project.
Assess the impact of engineering solutions in a global, economic, environmental, and societal context.

column2: Communication. Communicate effectively on complex electrical engineering activities with the community, and the society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations and give and receive clear instructions;

column3: Acquire knowledge to develop written and oral communication skills appropriate to the profession of electrical engineering.
Develop oral and visual communication skills appropriate to the profession of electrical engineering
Demonstrate competence in writing and presentation of engineering reports,  and communication letters.

column2: Environment and Sustainability. Recognize the impact of professional engineering solutions in societal, global, and environmental contexts and demonstrate knowledge of and need for sustainable development;

column3: Acquire an understanding of the impact of engineering solutions in soceital, global, and environmental context.
Apply knowledge of sustainable development to engineering solutions with considerations to soceital, global, economic, and environmental issues.
Demonstrate knowledge of and need of solutions for sustainable development

column2: Lifelong Learning. Recognize the need for, and ability to engage in independent and lifelong learning in the broadest context of technological change.

column3: Acquire lifelong learning knowledge and skills needed to motivate self to engage in further studies.
Apply learned knowledge and skills in promoting engineering solutions toward deeper interest/motivation to pursue further studies.
Engage in other lifelong learning activities for professional advancement and development.

column2: The Engineer and Society. Apply reasoning based on contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal, cultural, contemporary issues, and the consequent responsibilities relevant to professional engineering practices.

column3: Acquire knowledge of current events, developments, and issues in the technical and non-technical space at the regional, national and global level.
Apply reasoning based on contextual knowledge about the current developments and trends relevant to the field of engineering.
Assess the consequent responsibilities of engineering solutions to societal, health, legal, cultural, and contemporary issues relevant to professional engineering practices.

column2: Modern Tool Usage. Apply appropriate techniques, skills, and modern engineering and IT tools to complex electrical engineering activities;

column3: Acquire knowledge and techniques of using modern engineering and IT tools.
Apply learned techniques using modern and IT tools to simulate complex engineering activities
Use commercial software as tools for system design and analysis.

column2: Project Management and Finance. Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of engineering management and financial principles as a member or a leader of a team to manage projects in multidisciplinary settings, and identify opportunities of entrepreneurship.

column3: Acquire knowledge and understanding of engineering management and financial principles for managing projects.
Identify opportunities and be involved in entrepreneurial engagements.
Demonstrate knowledge of engineering management and cost analysis applied to an engineering project.

column2: Social and National Responsibility. Apply acquired engineering knowledge and skills in addressing community problems that contribute to national development.

column3: Acquire knowledge and understanding of the community problems that needs engineering solutions.
Apply the acquired knowledge and skills  in provind solutions to community problems.
Participate actively in providing solutions to community problems that promote national development.
